name: c-stepper-40
title: Stepper with side rail and step icons
description: 6 incident response steps as rows with their own icons, a blue bar on the current row, green checks on done rows and the step detail beside them.

"use client" import { useRef, useState } from "react" import { Frame, FramePanel } from "@/components/reui/frame" import { Stepper, StepperContent, StepperIndicator, StepperItem, StepperNav, StepperPanel, StepperTitle, StepperTrigger, } from "@/components/reui/stepper" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" const steps = [ { title: "Resolution", detail: "Pick the fix: roll api-gateway back to v2.14.1.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Scoping", detail: "Limit the change to 6 pods in eu-west-1.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Execution", detail: "Replace the pods one at a time.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Verification", detail: "Watch error rate and p95 latency for 10 min.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Approval", detail: "The incident lead signs off on the fix.", icon: ( ), }, { title: "Summary", detail: "Record the root cause and follow-ups.", icon: ( ), }, ] const completed = ( ) export function Pattern() { const [current, setCurrent] = useState(3) const prevRef = useRef(null) const nextRef = useRef(null) // One past the last step marks every step complete. No tab is selected // then, so the last one keeps the tablist's tab stop. const allDone = current > steps.length function goTo(step: number) { setCurrent(step) // The pressed button disables itself at either end, so focus moves to // its partner. if (step === 1) nextRef.current?.focus() if (step > steps.length) prevRef.current?.focus() } return (
{/* A bare frame that paints nothing: it only hands each row its per-style radius, padding and border color. 6px of block padding around the 20px text-sm line keeps the drawn 34px row. */} {steps.map((item, index) => { const step = index + 1 // Every row is a panel whose border stays transparent until it // is active, so the selection moves without shifting a row, and // gap-1.5 absorbs that border to keep the design's row pitch. // 3px under the ghost panel radius lands on the drawn 8px. The // theme has no blue token, so the active row takes blue-500. return ( {item.icon} {item.title} {step < current && ( , completed )} {step === current && ( )} ) })} {/* Stacked, 9px (a row's 1px border plus its 8px inline padding) lines the copy up with the step icons above it. */} {/* Decorative, so hidden from assistive tech: a line across while the columns stack, a line between them once they sit side by side. */}
